ruleset.name: loudsight-bestpractices
ruleset.description:
PMD's bundled bestpractices category, restricted to main sources.
The parent sets includeTests=true so loudsight-pmd-rules.xml (the UTC timestamp contract) also covers test code, where the same default-zone hazard exists. But bestpractices is a general style category that has never been applied to this project's tests, and turning it on wholesale surfaced 342 pre-existing violations across four modules alone - enough to fail every build.
Excluding test paths here scopes the widened analysis to exactly what was intended. The alternative - relaxing failurePriority so only priority-1 rules are fatal - would have downgraded bestpractices to warnings on MAIN sources too, weakening a gate that currently passes clean. Note also that splitting this across two plugin executions does NOT work: maven-pmd-plugin's check goal forks the pmd goal, and the fork ignores execution-specific configuration, so the second execution silently analyses nothing and reports success.
